_about: Ad hooks for message match: /breathe?h=<id> puts the ad's exact first line in the headline slot and preselects its session (variants a-e). The seven lines are the ads' own (lead, 28 Sep); unknown ids are ignored. Swedish lines not written yet. sub_en: the line under the headline in variant f (what happens next, echoing the ad's end card). 'night' is a draft from the landing loop; no ad uses it yet.

coffee.sub_en: Try 6 minutes of breathing with Edvin instead. Free, no app needed.

email.sub_en: 6 minutes of breathing with Edvin first. Free, no app needed.

parked.line_en: Parked outside. Not ready to go in.
parked.sub_en: Take 6 minutes with Edvin first. Free, no app needed.

slowest.line_en: The slowest breath of your day.
slowest.sub_en: 6 minutes of slow breathing with Edvin. Free, no app needed.

exhale.sub_en: Find out in 6 minutes with Edvin. Free, no app needed.

rate.sub_en: Ask again after 6 minutes with Edvin. Free, no app needed.

keepup.line_en: Can you keep up with this?
keepup.sub_en: About 50 fast breaths in half a minute. 6 minutes with Edvin, free.

night.sub_en: 6 slow minutes with Edvin. Fine to do lying down. Free.
night.draft: landing loop, 28 Sep: a line for the one who can't switch off; no ad uses it yet (for the ads loop)
